material: Unlit/Texture; shading/AO baked. Main atlas contains its small glow accents; emissive mask is optional for the host.
highQualityOption: The authoring main atlas is 4096px. Raise the import maximum only after profiling a target phone.
estimateNote: Texture storage estimate only; excludes meshes, render buffers, driver overhead, game/UI, camera capture and tracking. Not a measured device memory figure.
